concepts.content: The Mandela Fleming model connects monetary policies in different countries to movements in the exchange rate and examines how those movements affect real activity in the very short run.

source_grounding.validation_scope: exact quotation, chunk membership and field coverage only

So what the Mandela Fleming model is about,
 it's about first connecting these things,

 different monetary policies in different places,

 and what is the impact of that on aggregate demand,
 and hence on output, we're talking about the very short run,
 in the different parts of the world.
